field_rock_islands.asset: Seven distinct upright components from Coast Land Rocks 02
field_rock_islands.authors: Rob Tuytel, photography and processing; Rico Cilliers, cleanup
field_rock_islands.preparation: Pinned Godot 4.7.2 GLTFDocument reads the prepared Coast Land Rocks 02 GLB, groups indexed triangles by connected vertex component, and selects ranked islands 4, 7, 12, 14, 15, 17, 19 by descending triangle count. Each is recentered in X/Z and grounded at its lowest Y, preserving indexed positions, normals, tangents and original scan UVs. The seven islands total 7,103 triangles and use the GLB's shared albedo and normal textures. Private preparation script: coast-land-rocks-source/extract_rocks.gd.

limits: The photographed rocks, gravel and copper material are presentation only. Source glTF files remain in the task private family; the existing mineral-soil texture and original physical source retain their own provenance. Passive renders cannot establish player collision, collector clearance, depletion in ordinary play, or performance.
